text:
elaine: quick heads-up — onboarding canary for tempest-v2q (int8) shows NDJSON concat failures in the toolcall suite. parse_fail jumped from 0.5% -> 4.7% at ~15:10 UTC.
harry: which slice + config?
elaine: 3k toolcall slice-id tc-2026-03-24-x. model=tempst-v2q, quant=int8, batch=10, kv_replay=enabled, streaming=on.
bench-ci: summary: job bc-17466; samples=3000; parse_failure=0.047; common_err=missing-comma-between-objects.
jose: can you paste a sanitized example?
elaine: pasted minimal fail:
[{"action":"call","name":"lookup","arguments":{"id":"100"}}{"action":"call","name":"lookup","arguments":{"id":"101"}}]
harry: looks like two objects merged without the comma; suspect replayed prefix or streaming chunk boundary. int8 tends to lower punctuation token prob.
elaine: triage plan: 1) rerun with kv_replay=false 2) run int16 with same kernel 3) ship SDK canary patch: ndjson-insert-comma fallback (tag repaired calls with x-ndjson-repaired) 4) collect token logits for 100 failures.
jose: I'll run (1) and collect logits. harry, can you land SDK patch for canary?
harry: yes, small function in SDK: try ndjson split on '}{' and insert comma, reparse, then set header. will keep canary-only flag.
bench-ci: queued bc-17467 (kv_replay=false, limit=1000).
bench-ci: bc-17467 interim: parse_fail -> 0.011 after 1k. strong signal kv_replay amplification.
elaine: owners: jose -> logits + kv_replay gating; harry -> SDK repair + telemetry header; elaine -> push failing samples to s3://eng-ml/goldens/tempest-v2q/ and hold promotion.
bench-ci: bc-17468 (full 3k with repair on, kv_replay=false) completed: repaired_success_fraction=0.052; final_parse_fail=0.009; false_repair_est=0.001 on gold subset. logs: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-17468/logs
elaine: temporary mitigations: block kv_replay for tempest-v2q-int8, enable SDK ndjson repair for canary, ingest gold cases. next steps: tokenizer/quant calibration with model team.
harry: will add unit test for streaming chunk boundary + batch sizes 1/10/32. done.
elaine: closing when dashboard <1% for 24h.
sdk-bot: incident INC-17466 created for tracking.
